Landed as a77bf047804.

- **What:** Advisor, an experimental Labs plugin (default off). It reviews an agent's ongoing work every N tool calls or M minutes, by forking the session's own context at cached-input prices. When it finds clearly avoidable work, it steers the run with one short correction, after a second fork verifies it.
- **Safety:** decisions fail closed. A review never runs while a tool call is in flight: built-in calls settle on their result event, and Codex calls on native item completion, including outer code-mode calls. Only user-triggered runs are admitted. Review guidance can be edited on the settings page; the output contract and the verify step stay fixed.
- **Cost:** no history-carrying hooks, and events are filtered by phase with metadata-only payloads. On ordinary turns the host clones about 1.4 KB for Advisor, where the earlier design cloned up to about 1.3 MB.
- **Proof:** blind-holdout evaluation (luna and sol: 0 false corrections, 100% recall, 95% quality); live runs on Codex and built-in (exact call counts, safe-boundary dispatch); 77 plugin tests; exact-head CI green.
